_readme: Edit this file to add / change quests. Save and refresh the app - no restart needed. Each task: id (unique), title, hint, reward (points), kind. kind = 'pulse' (auto: done when you pulse today) | 'streak' (auto: add "target": N) | 'wallet' (auto: done when a wallet is connected) | 'link' (opens "url" then completes) | 'manual' (tap to complete). Optional "repeat": "daily" (default) or "once". For 'link' add a "url". Order here = order shown.
